primary_goal: 在不重开 H28 request coverage、H34 prediction identity 或 H31 semantic negative scan 的前提下，检查评估/API结果状态、失败/缺失和可视化/文本口径是否存在可复现不一致。
method: prepare -> verify -> predict -> score -> review -> promote

baseline.role: H34 negative prediction/generalization scan plus H28 evaluation contract

direction_switch_reason: H34 预测输入/coverage 负向收口；评估/API方向自 H28 后未独立重开，H35 检查结果状态、失败/缺失和显示口径，不重复 request coverage。
recent_directions: H34:预测输入/泛化负向扫描

scope.candidate: evaluation/API result status, missing/failed cells, serialization and UI/text status consistency
exclude: Native accuracy claims without independent Native data

problem_domain_closure.rule: 同一评估状态根因直接影响的评分、失败/缺失、序列化、API 和可视化入口必须同轮收口；无候选保留负结论。

data_roles.development: fresh evaluation/API source scan and controlled missing/failed probes
data_roles.holdout: independent result status and UI/text controls
data_roles.final_acceptance: evaluation/API mechanism only; no Native accuracy unless independently observed

guardrails: 不得重复 H28 request coverage
不得把状态/显示单测称为精度改善
没有 Native 时只报告评估机制
失败/缺失不可静默当作通过
next_step: 完成独立 evaluation/API source scan，登记唯一可证伪候选。
